source_text: A 2017 systematic risk-benefit analysis of early infant male circumcision quantified the net advantage, estimating that benefits exceed procedural risks by ratios up to 200:1, as the procedure averts multiple conditions including phimosis (affecting up to 1 in 2 uncircumcised males lifetime), balanitis, and inflammatory conditions requiring intervention. [44]
